title: Japanese Lamb Doner Kebab
description: A creative twist on traditional doner kebab, featuring lamb and Japanese flavors. Grill the lamb to perfection and serve in a crispy Turkish-style pita.
instructions: Season the lamb doner meat with kebab spices, salt, and pepper.
Grill the lamb for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 63°C.
Slice the lamb into thin strips.
Warm the Turkish pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble the doner kebab by placing the grilled lamb onto the pita bread, followed by a dollop of Japanese teriyaki sauce, some snappy lettuce, and a slice of quick pickled cucumber.
